mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_ID, B.MEMBER_ID, CATEGORY, TITLE, COUNT, B.CREATE_AT, UPDATE_AT, TO_CHAR(B.CREATE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATE_AT_STR, NVL(M.NICKNAME, '탈퇴한 회원') AS WRITER_NICKNAME FROM TB_BOARD B LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY BOARD_ID DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_BOARD.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_BOARD (BOARD_ID, MEMBER_ID, CATEGORY, TITLE, CONTENT) VALUES (#{boardId}, #{memberId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content})

INSERT INTO TB_BOARD_IMAGE (IMAGE_ID, BOARD_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, SAVE_NAME, IMAGE_PATH, IMAGE_ORDER) VALUES (SEQ_BOARD_IMAGE.NEXTVAL, #{boardId}, #{originalName}, #{saveName}, #{imagePath}, #{imageOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BOARD SET COUNT = COUNT + 1 WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_ID, B.MEMBER_ID, CATEGORY, TITLE, COUNT, B.CREATE_AT, UPDATE_AT, CONTENT, TO_CHAR(B.CREATE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATE_AT_STR, TO_CHAR(B.UPDATE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATE_AT_STR, NVL(M.NICKNAME, '탈퇴한 회원') AS WRITER_NICKNAME FROM TB_BOARD B LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
